name: 46268 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46268 (Indianapolis) has 279 nonprofit organizations. 149 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 131 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46268 (Indianapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46268 (Indianapolis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 131 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
